ops.text: 11.4 Transition Assistance and Return of Data. Upon expiration or termination of this Agreement for any reason, and without limiting Corio's rights that survive under Section 11.3, Commerce One shall (i) at Corio's request, provide reasonable transition assistance to Corio and its Customers for a period of up to 6 months at Commerce One's then-current rates; (ii) within 30 days after expiration or termination of this Agreement, return to Corio all data of Corio, its Customers and Software Users in Commerce One's possession or control in a standard machine-readable format; and (iii) thereafter delete such data from its systems and certify such deletion to Corio in writing.

ops.oldText: each party shall otherwise return or destroy any Confidential Information
ops.newText: each party shall otherwise return or destroy any Confidential Information (subject, as to Corio data, to Section 11.4)

proposal.comment: [Playbook] We added an exit clause giving us up to 6 months of transition assistance at Commerce One's then-current rates, return of our data in a standard machine-readable format within 30 days after expiration or termination of this Agreement, and certified deletion thereafter, and cross-referenced it in 11.3 so the elective return-or-destroy right does not override it. Our playbook requires an orderly wind-down and data return on exit; 90 days of assistance is an acceptable fallback.
proposal.summary: Insert Section 11.4 requiring transition assistance and return of Corio data within 30 days after expiration or termination
